setup-worktree: # Copy required env files from the root worktree (best-effort, but loud)
# Optional: if you keep additional env overrides, copy them too (non-fatal)
setup-python: # Prefer mise if available, otherwise use system python/hatch
# Create/sync hatch env and install dev deps
command -v hatch >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "hatch not found; install hatch to work on the backend" && false)
setup-web: # Prefer mise if available, otherwise rely on system node/pnpm
command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "pnpm not found; install pnpm to work on ./web" && false)
setup-services-local: # Best-effort local services; skip cleanly if docker isn't present
command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "docker not found; skipping services" && exit 0)
